system.description:
Acquired with CR11 or higher. Deal [4D + (Attack Power)] physical damage to the target. If the target's HP is equal to its Max HP, increase the damage by +[STR base].

A special skill that swings down the weapon with all the power of the whole body and flashes the enemy from the front. A decisive blow that converges all the weight and physical strength of the weapon into one point, cutting the enemy's body in half.
